title: Beautiful, sturdy, easy to assemble!
text: Beautiful, sturdy, easy to assemble!. The product looks exactly as advertised, is a decent size to fit lots of items/decor into it, and very well made, it’s def sturdy and looks amazing! The color is a bright white with mild distressing that isn’t overdone. It feels like an actual wood product and is painted well! No odd smells or anything like that. Excellent product, do not hesitate to buy.
